historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes channel load, but tailing output and counting lines cannot establish which sensor disappeared or whether values, units and statuses remain valid.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires complete samples, sensor-specific policies and rate/load controls for the full 12-hour read-only endurance window.
historical_reviews.history: The shared code also identifies Functionality row 1669, a different BMC Time case; source row and variant ID keep this SDR stress identity separate.
historical_reviews.v3_1: SDR stability is not equivalent to a constant line count. Each sample needs stable record identity plus reading, unit, status and timestamp; legitimately zero, disabled and unavailable states must be distinguished per sensor rather than rejected globally.

original_test_intent: Continuously exercise BMC SDR reads for 12 hours and verify management remains responsive while every expected sensor retains a valid identity, status and plausible reading.
original_method: On an approved recoverable BMC, poll the complete `sdr elist` at a bounded rate, retain raw samples or verified hashes with anomaly snapshots, compare each record to a versioned inventory and sensor-specific value/status policy, monitor IPMI latency/resource health and preserve SEL/OS deltas without clearing them.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the authoritative SDR inventory and per-sensor semantics, approves the rate and 12-hour window, and reviews any sensor or BMC-load anomaly before deciding the verdict.
required_inputs: Versioned SDR repository and expected record inventory
Per-sensor units, valid ranges and status policy
safety_requirements: Do not clear or rewrite SDR/SEL
Throttle polling to the approved rate
Monitor latency, timeouts and evidence capacity
Stop on inventory drift, unexplained value/status, repeated timeout or management instability
Do not automatically retry after loss of recovery
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact variant and BMC target
Poll complete `sdr elist` at bounded rate
Validate each record and sample timestamp
Monitor BMC latency and log deltas
Stop and report anomalies without verdict
engineer_actions: Review sensor drift and BMC-load anomalies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SDR read is relevant, but `tail` discards most sensors and `wc -l` detects neither wrong values nor status/unit changes; command-line credentials and an unbounded loop also violate the evidence and safety needs.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Poll complete protected `ipmitool sdr elist` output at the owner-approved bounded interval for 12 hours, parse every record against the exact inventory/policy and retain raw anomalies plus BMC latency and log evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 12-hour scope and 20 attended/1440 machine minutes remain; the source's complete SDR intent is preserved while blanket log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Track each sensor by stable record identity and collect presence, type, unit, status, numeric value, timestamp and threshold relation, with per-interval completeness and management latency.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces tailed output and line counts with full record-level validation under a bounded resource budget.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A stable count can hide one sensor replacing another, stale values, wrong units, unavailable status or an invalid zero reading.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some event-only or discrete sensors do not have meaningful numeric ranges, and zero may be valid; authoritative per-sensor semantics are mandatory.

project_override_considerations: The Project must bind this duplicate code to row 1646's Stress/BMC SDR identity and supply the firmware-specific inventory and policies. Row 1669's time-setting variant must never be merged into this review.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant, BMC identity, inventory and sensor-policy versions
Approved rate/duration, parser and watchdog configuration
Timestamped complete sample coverage and record-level results
Raw anomaly samples, latency/resource and timeout history
Final SDR/BMC health plus preserved SEL/OS deltas

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: This exact row's Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently describe 12-hour SDR polling. The duplicate code points to a separately identified BMC Time row and is handled by source-row/variant identity rather than creating an internal conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Expected inventory, sensor policies and polling controls are normal owner/package inputs. Execution blocks only if exact variant/target or safe resource limits cannot be established.

review_improvement: Prevents a count-only or truncated poll from passing while individual sensors disappear, become stale, change status/unit or report semantically invalid zero values.
independent_technical_reasoning: SDR records are heterogeneous: threshold sensors, discrete states and unavailable readings have different validity rules. Record order can change and management responses can be partial under load. Stable record identifiers and per-type evaluation, combined with response completeness and latency, are required to separate real sensor failure from parsing or channel saturation.
